instruction: Buy me a cutting board from my amazon wishlist that will fit in my kitchen drawer of 12.0X9.6 (LxW) inches.
notes: Single-app (amazon) purchase task. The wish list contents and product dimensions are unknown initially, so show_wish_list gates product lookups and show_product (which returns length/width) must be called on a candidate before it can be added to the cart; the world facts (cutting-board, fits-drawer) are static in :init and encode which candidate satisfies L<=12.0, W<=9.6 - at runtime the agent checks every cutting board on the wish list and picks one that fits. The product is added with add_product_to_cart (not move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart) because the evaluation forbids changes to wish-list entries. clear_cart is required before adding so the resulting order contains exactly one product (pre-existing cart items would otherwise be ordered too). Payment card and address ids are discovered via show_payment_cards / show_addresses (no address may be modified or deleted). place_order creates the order; complete_task takes no answer argument since the task is not a question.
